statement: A monster's effect that applies without being activated is a Continuous Effect when it applies from the Monster Zone. One that applies off the field too (the GY, the hand, banished), such as "This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon" while on the field or in the GY", is classed as none of Ignition, Trigger, Quick or Continuous: an unclassified effect (UNCLASSIFIED). It is still an effect: negating the card's effects stops it. A monster card in a Spell & Trap Zone is a Spell or Trap there, and its effects are classed as one's (Centur-Ion Primera's FAQ, card 19372, ②: an effect that makes no chain link, treated as a Continuous Trap's).

sources.name: Cyber Dragon Core
sources.says: Its name becoming "Cyber Dragon" on the field or in the GY is an effect classed as none of Ignition, Trigger, Quick or Continuous (起動効果、誘発効果、誘発即時効果、永続効果のいずれにも分類されない効果です). Of the FAQs whose numbered monster effect applies while the card is in the GY or hand (names, Gemini monsters treated as Normal Monsters), 12 say the same and none says Continuous; Magician of Chaos (14213, ①) and Amazoness Baby Tiger (13173, ①) among them (read by Claude, 2026-11-20, from db-ygoresources-com/yugioh-faq-history).

sources.name: Proto-Cyber Dragon
sources.says: Its "This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon" while on the field", which applies only on the field, is a Continuous Effect (永続効果です). Of the FAQs that say where a monster's Continuous Effect applies, 1,596 say the Monster Zone.

sources.name: Relinkuriboh
sources.says: ② ("If your monster would be destroyed by battle, you can banish this card from your GY instead"), a replacement that applies from the GY, is an effect classed as none of Ignition, Trigger, Quick or Continuous (起動効果・誘発効果・誘発即時効果・永続効果のいずれにも分類されない効果です); so is PSY-Frame Multi-Threader's ② from the hand (card 12619, 2016-07-09), where a monster's replacement on the field is a Continuous Effect (Gravekeeper's Visionary, card 8638; Naglfar, Generaider Boss of Fire, card 14773).

scripts: Scripts don't class effects this way: they register both as EFFECT_CHANGE_CODE (aux.EnableChangeCode with the places).
